digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI workflows
propositions: External integration tests run live against only Anthropic provider, leaving Bedrock and OpenAI provider regressions undetectable by CI automation.
Provider selection must be a matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm independently verified against its credentialed provider.
Bedrock arm credential resolution via OIDC role assumption to a scoped IAM role is required for GitHub-hosted runners, and must fail loudly when region is unresolved rather than skip silently.

Config file overlay via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must set only [llm.model_classes] and preserve other discovered config, and cfg.model ambient default fallback must also resolve to the declared provider.
Test assertions must cover both class-based provider selection and ambient default cfg.model to prevent partial overlays that leave some operations on the default Anthropic provider.
